intro: Inquire at the Inn is an Alliance quest in Darkshire that continues the investigation into the mysterious stranger connected to Sven Yorgen's ruined farm. Directed by Clerk Daltry, adventurers take a recovered journal to the Scarlet Raven Tavern to question Tavernkeep Smitts about who stayed there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.
You might want to expand your search to the inn. If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.
If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh yeah, I remember this book. Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.
He left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something. Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.
The first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
